Introducing Surrati Omniyat Eau De Parfum . A luxurious 140ml unisex fragrance designed to embody sophistication and grace. Part of Surrati's prestigious Heritage Collection, this Eau De Parfum is a refined blend of vibrant Black Currant, Peach and Passionfruit, sweet Caramel and Strawberry, and a warm Vanilla and Sandalwood foundation, reflecting confidence and individuality in every spritz.. . . Key Features of Omniyat Eau De Parfum: . . Generous 140ml Eau De Parfum Strength: A substantial and luxurious supply of this captivating fragrance, ensuring powerful projection, excellent sillage, and a long-lasting experience that embodies sophistication and grace.. Complex Fruity, Caramel & Vanilla Accord: A unique and vibrant composition featuring a bright blend of Black Currant, Green Tangerine, Peach, and Passionfruit, enriched by a sweet, creamy heart of Caramel and Vanilla for a timelessly indulgent character.. Confidence & Individuality: A captivating aroma from Surrati's distinguished Heritage Collection, crafted to reflect the wearer's unique sophistication and effortlessly refined self-expression for both men's and women's fragrance collections.. Warm Vanilla, Amber & Sandalwood Base: Features a rich and enduring dry-down of Vanilla, Musk, Amber, and Sandalwood, ensuring a warm, luxurious, and persistently elegant finish.. Omniyat Scent Profile & Notes: . . Omniyat is a unique olfactory journey that opens with an intensely vibrant and fruity burst, transitions to a rich, sweet and floral core, and settles into a warm, luxuriously sophisticated base of enduring elegance.. Top Notes: A bright and complex opening of Black Currant, Green Tangerine, Peach, and Passionfruit, instantly creating an atmosphere of vibrant, luscious, and irresistibly captivating fruity freshness.. Heart Notes: A delicious and richly indulgent core of sweet Strawberry and Caramel, paired with the creamy elegance of Gardenia, providing the composition's warm, sweet, and sophisticatedly refined central structure.. Base Notes: A rich and enduring finish of Vanilla, Musk, Amber, and Sandalwood, settling the fragrance into a warm, persistent, and memorably luxurious dry-down.. The Essence of Modern Authenticity . . Omniyat is more than a scent; it's an invisible accessory of power. Its luxurious Fruity, Caramel, and Vanilla structure ensures an unforgettable impression that reflects who you are.. .

Key Features of Atlantis Eau de Parfum: . . Generous 140 ml Size: A substantial and luxurious supply of this invigorating fragrance, offering excellent value and ensuring reliable, consistent daily wear for those who seek a crisp, distinct, and modern aromatic experience.. Invigorating Aquatic & Mint Accord: A uniquely refreshing and cooling composition defined by the combination of aquatic and mint notes, delivering an instant rush of cool, clean freshness and a distinctly modern, energetic character.. Confidence & Individuality: A beautifully balanced and modern unisex composition, crafted to reflect the wearer's unique personality and effortlessly crisp self-expression, making it an ideal choice for all fragrance lovers.. Unique Rose & Dates Base: Features an unexpectedly warm and subtly sweet dry-down of delicate rose and rich dates, grounding the freshness with depth, complexity, and a sophisticatedly distinctive finish.. Atlantis Scent Profile & Notes: . . Atlantis is a crisp and invigorating olfactory journey that sails from a sunny, bright fruity opening to a cool, minty center, finally settling into a warm, subtly sweet base of enduring and distinctive elegance.. Top Notes: A bright and exhilarating opening of vibrant citrus blended with lively fruity accords, instantly creating an atmosphere of energetic, refreshing, and irresistibly invigorating freshness.. Heart Notes: A cool and distinctly refreshing core of aquatic notes combined with the crisp, clean lift of mint, providing the composition's uniquely modern, cooling, and sophisticatedly energetic central structure.. Base Notes: A warm and unexpectedly complex finish of delicate rose and rich dates, grounding the fragrance with subtle sweetness, depth, and a memorably distinctive dry-down.. The Essence of Modern Authenticity . . Atlantis is more than a scent; it's an invisible accessory of power. Its fresh citrus, aquatic, and mint structure ensures an unforgettable impression that reflects who you are.. .

Valley 33 – Oriental Woody / Aromatic. Harnessing the evocative power of heritage and modern sophistication, Valley 33 is a masterful Unisex composition within the Oriental Woody / Aromatic family. This scent is designed for those who appreciate a fragrance that evolves with complexity, moving from bright, spiced citrus to a deep, resinous finish.. The Olfactory Journey . The Top: Vibrant & Spirited The experience opens with the herbal sweetness of Davana , perfectly complemented by the crisp, citrus sparkle of Italian Bergamot . A touch of Pink Pepper adds a contemporary, rosy spice that immediately captures the senses.. The Heart: Rich & Earthy As the initial brightness settles, the fragrance reveals a majestic heart of Oud and White Amber . These traditional ingredients are given a fresh, botanical twist with the inclusion of Rosemary , creating a bridge between classic Eastern perfumery and modern aromatic profiles.. The Base: Sensual & Grounded The dry-down is a lingering, sophisticated embrace of Musk and Vetiver . This combination provides a clean yet deeply earthy foundation that ensures the fragrance remains poised and enduring on the skin..

Experience the rich elegance of Cuban Latte, a luxurious unisex fragrance crafted for lovers of warm oriental floral and gourmand scents. The fragrance opens with a vibrant blend of fresh orange and roasted coffee beans, creating an addictive and energizing first impression. At its heart, delicate Turkish rose and soft mimosa add a refined floral touch that perfectly balances the deep gourmand character. The scent settles into a long-lasting base of patchouli, creamy tonka bean, and earthy vetiver, leaving behind a smooth, sophisticated trail.. Cuban Latte is designed for those who appreciate bold yet elegant fragrances with a comforting coffee-inspired warmth. Perfect for both day and evening wear, this 150ml perfume delivers a unique blend of sweetness, florals, and woody depth that makes every moment memorable..

Candy Kiss . A Symphony of Sweetness and Sophistication . Indulge in the playful yet refined allure of Candy Kiss , a fragrance designed for the woman who embraces her vibrant femininity. Inspired by the whimsical essence of Vanilla Candy Rock Sugar , this Amber Vanilla Gourmand scent offers a multi-layered sensory experience that lingers beautifully on the skin.. The Scent Journey . The First Impression: The fragrance opens with a bright, joyful burst of zesty Lemon and sweet Strawberry , creating an immediate sense of sparkling energy.. . The Heart: At its core, the unique addition of Guaiac Wood provides a subtle, smoky depth that perfectly balances the initial sweetness with a touch of modern mystery.. . The Lingering Trail: As it settles, the scent transforms into a warm, decadent embrace of creamy Vanilla, rich Caramel, and sophisticated Dry Amber .. .

Surrati Pur Musk . Pur Musk is a cornerstone of Surrati’s collection, celebrated for its extreme purity and "second-skin" feel. It is a minimalist, velvety fragrance that embodies the scent of fresh linen and clean skin. Unlike heavy ouds or sweet florals, this scent is prized for its soft, powdery texture and its ability to act as a versatile base for layering with other perfumes.. Fragrance Profile: A Clean Floral-Musk composition that is light, airy, and creamy.. . Key Notes: A dominant core of White Musk , accented by Lily of the Valley , Soft Rose , and a smooth Powdery Accord .. . Best Use: The perfect everyday "clean" scent; ideal for the office, post-shower freshness, or as a base layer to increase the longevity of other fragrances.. . Performance: Exceptional "close-to-skin" longevity; it creates a subtle, comforting aura rather than a loud trail.. . Vibe: Innocent, crystalline, fresh, and calming.. . Target Audience: Perfect for those who prefer "non-perfume" scents or want a professional, understated fragrance that smells naturally clean.. .

Surrati Dubai Ocean . Dubai Ocean is a high-performance aquatic fragrance that captures the refreshing essence of the Arabian Gulf. It is a "powerhouse" fresh scent, designed to remain crisp and revitalizing even in the intense heat and humidity of the UAE. By blending sharp citrus with deep marine accords and a clean woody base, it offers a sophisticated alternative to traditional heavy ouds, perfect for the modern, active professional.. Fragrance Profile: A Citrus-Marine-Aromatic composition that is cooling, salty, and sharp.. . Key Notes: Opens with a burst of Sea Salt , Grapefruit , and Bergamot , moving into a heart of Seaweed and Neroli , anchored by a base of Ambergris and Cedarwood .. . Best Use: The ultimate "daytime" fragrance for Dubai; perfect for the office, outdoor meetings, or casual weekend wear.. . Performance: Engineered for heat; it features exceptional projection for a fresh scent and a "chilling" effect that lasts throughout the day.. . Vibe: Refreshing, athletic, clean, and expansive.. . Target Audience: Ideal for those who enjoy scents like Bvlgari Aqua or Davidoff Cool Water but want the superior oil concentration and longevity Surrati is known for.. .

Surrati Oud Dubai . Oud Dubai is a prestigious fragrance that pays homage to the luxury and opulence of the Middle East. It is a masterful blend of traditional heritage and modern sophistication, capturing the vibrant, high-end spirit of the city. This scent is defined by its rich, resinous depth balanced with refined woody accords, making it a "modern classic" oud that is wearable yet unmistakably grand.. Fragrance Profile: A Woody-Oriental masterpiece that balances raw, earthy agarwood with a polished, smooth finish.. . Key Notes: Features a prominent Cambodian Oud heart, layered with Saffron , Patchouli , and a touch of Sandalwood to soften the wood’s intensity.. . Best Use: Highly versatile for the region; perfect for evening events, weddings, and cold, air-conditioned environments.. . Performance: High-performance scent with heavy projection and "beast mode" longevity that lingers on skin and fabrics for hours.. . Vibe: Opulent, regal, warm, and expensive.. . Target Audience: Ideal for connoisseurs of authentic oud who want a smooth, sophisticated fragrance that commands respect without being overly harsh.. .

Surrati Arabic Coffee . Arabic Coffee is a rich, aromatic fragrance that captures the soulful essence of traditional Arabian hospitality. It is a warm and inviting scent that perfectly replicates the smell of freshly roasted beans, spiced with traditional cardamom and balanced with a subtle floral sweetness. This fragrance is designed for those who appreciate "gourmand" scents that are grounded in culture and history, offering a comforting yet sophisticated olfactory experience.. Fragrance Profile: A Warm Gourmand-Oriental composition that is spicy, earthy, and deeply aromatic.. . Key Notes: Features a heart of Freshly Roasted Coffee Beans and Green Cardamom , often layered with Turkish Rose and a base of Warm Spices and Musk .. . Best Use: Ideal for afternoon wear, social gatherings, and cooler evenings; it creates a cozy, welcoming atmosphere.. . Performance: Strong longevity with a moderate, pleasant sillage that smells like an inviting café or a traditional Majlis.. . Vibe: Welcoming, earthy, aromatic, and cultural.. . Target Audience: Perfect for coffee lovers and those who want a unique, "non-traditional" oriental scent that stands out from typical ouds and florals.. .

Surrati Luxury Oud . Luxury Oud is a premium fragrance that represents the pinnacle of Arabian perfumery. It is a deep, multifaceted scent designed to showcase the complexity of high-grade agarwood without the sharp "medicinal" edge found in lesser blends. By combining traditional oud with soft, resinous undertones, it creates an aura of prestige and timelessness, making it one of the most sought-after selections for formal occasions in the Middle East.. Fragrance Profile: A Rich Oriental-Woody scent characterized by its smooth, balsamic depth and earthy warmth.. . Key Notes: Features a heart of Premium Cambodian Oud , enriched with Damask Rose , Frankincense (Luban) , and a warm, golden Amber base.. . Best Use: Reserved for formal events, evening wear, and religious or cultural celebrations.. . Performance: Incredible longevity and a regal sillage that projects a sense of luxury and status.. . Vibe: Grand, traditional, warm, and authoritative.. . Target Audience: Ideal for those who appreciate the authentic, "royal" smell of traditional Arabian hospitality and luxury.. .

Surrati Cuban Tobacco . Cuban Tobacco is an intense, charismatic fragrance that captures the smoky, honeyed essence of a premium cigar lounge. It is a bold "gourmand-tobacco" scent that balances rugged masculinity with a refined, sweet smoothness. Known for its warmth and complexity, it is a statement fragrance that feels both cozy and powerful, making it a favorite for those who want a scent with a strong, distinctive character.. Fragrance Profile: A rich Amber-Woody composition with heavy smoky and sweet accords.. . Key Notes: A dominant Tobacco Leaf accord blended with Vanilla , Spices , and Cacao , anchored by a base of Dry Fruits and Woody notes .. . Best Use: Best suited for evening wear, winter months, or formal night-time events.. . Performance: Exceptional longevity and a warm, enveloping sillage that leaves a memorable trail.. . Vibe: Bold, sophisticated, warm, and mysterious.. . Target Audience: Ideal for those who enjoy "darker" scents like Tom Ford's Tobacco Vanille style—perfect for someone wanting a high-end, luxury feel.. . .

Surrati Oud De Dubai . Oud De Dubai is a prestigious fragrance that pays homage to the luxury and opulence of the Middle East. It is a masterful blend of traditional heritage and modern sophistication, capturing the vibrant spirit of Dubai. This scent is defined by its rich, resinous depth balanced with sweet, airy top notes, making it a "modern classic" oud that is wearable yet unmistakably grand.. Fragrance Profile: A Woody-Oriental masterpiece that balances raw, earthy agarwood with refined sweetness.. . Key Notes: Features a prominent Cambodian Oud base, layered with Saffron , Patchouli , and a touch of Caramel or Vanilla to soften the wood’s intensity.. . Best Use: Highly versatile for the region; perfect for evening events, weddings, and cold, air-conditioned environments.. . Performance: High-performance scent with heavy projection and "beast mode" longevity that lingers on clothes for days.. . Vibe: Opulent, regal, warm, and expensive.. . Target Audience: Ideal for connoisseurs of authentic oud who want a smooth, polished fragrance that commands respect without being overly harsh.. . . .

Surrati Sara . Sara is a delicate and ultra-feminine fragrance that celebrates classic floral elegance. Fragrance Profile: A light, airy Floral-Musk composition with a prominent powdery finish.. . Key Notes: A beautiful harmony of White Rose , Lily of the Valley , and Soft Musk , often accented by a touch of Vanilla for sweetness.. . Best Use: Excellent for daily wear, office environments, and casual daytime outings where a subtle, pleasant aroma is desired.. . Performance: Known for its "close-to-skin" projection (sillage), providing a clean, fresh-out-of-the-shower feel that lasts throughout the day.. . Vibe: Romantic, innocent, fresh, and sophisticated.. . Target Audience: Ideal for those who love "clean" scents and classic, soft florals that aren't overly sweet or heavy.. .

Surrati Bora Bora . Bora Bora by Surrati is an exotic, tropical fragrance designed to evoke the essence of a sun-drenched island paradise. It balances a sparkling, clean opening with a lush heart of white florals and a smooth, creamy base, making it a premier choice for warm-weather wear and those who prefer a vibrant, vacation-inspired aesthetic.. Top Notes: A bright, refreshing blend of Mandarin Orange , Aldehydes , and Bergamot for an immediate sense of freshness.. . Heart Notes: An intoxicating tropical bouquet featuring Tiare Flower , Tuberose , Jasmine , and Orange Blossom .. . Base Notes: A warm, lingering finish of Sandalwood , White Musk , and a hint of Coconut for a velvety dry-down.. . Fragrance Family: Floral - Tropical.. . Best Use: Ideal for daytime wear, outdoor events, and high-temperature climates like the UAE.. . Performance: High-concentration formula ensuring excellent longevity and a soft, elegant sillage.. . Vibe: Sophisticated, sunny, radiant, and breezy.. . .
